senses.gloss: m. pl. (birrus, βίῤῥος, v. בִּירוֹס; formed with a geographical termination, cmp. בִּרְדְּסִין) birrus, a cloak of thick woolen material.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:7">Kil. IX, 7</cite> (Ms. M. a. Ar. <he>בד׳</he>); Y. ib. 32ᵈ top <cite ref="B00385"><he>בּוּרְסִין</he></cite>; expl. <cite ref="B01248"><he>בריה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B00715"><he>בִּירְיָא</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 234">Sifré Deut. 234</cite> <cite ref="O00192"><he>סדסים</he></cite> read as <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 933:11">Yalk. ib. 933</cite> <he>בורס׳</he>.
